title: Oswald's planned role and the killing of Officer Tippit
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Oswald's planned role and the killing of Officer Tippit, about 1963 at Dallas, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

related.note: Both tell Sheehan's account of the plan for Oswald's shot and Tippit's role. Here Oswald shoots at Kennedy, while the story has a deliberate miss to blame Cuba.

plain: A lawyer named Dan Sheehan, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, passes on what he says he was told about the 1963 killing of President Kennedy in Dallas. According to Sheehan, the plan was for Lee Harvey Oswald, the man accused of the shooting, to fire at Kennedy and run, and then for a Dallas police officer named J. D. Tippit to kill Oswald. If true, it would mean the assassination was planned by others, with Oswald meant to be silenced.
